🚨 The Edrika Fulford Mutual Aid Fund reopens October 6 at 10am! 🚨 400 applications will be accepted online or by phone, entered into a lottery & undergo review. Submitting an app does not guarantee funding. 
💻 chicagohomeless.org/MAF  📞 (312) 641-4148 (Mon-Fri, 10am - 2pm)
Last call! 📣 The CCH Board Interest Form closes September 30. Interested in getting involved? Fill it out today: act.chicagohomeless.org/a/bo…

📢 INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITY 📢 CCH's Law Project is seeking an Intern to support their work in advocating for people experiencing homelessness in Chicago and throughout Illinois. 

Learn more here and apply: chicagohomeless.org/about/ca…

Our guide on how to vote if you are experiencing homelessness is here!  

Learn more: chicagohomeless.org/vote
It's Make-A-Will Month: write your will with FreeWill, our gift to you, and help the Chicago Coalition to End Homelessness advocate for a future where housing is a human right. bit.ly/45F4O5f

🚨Contact your state legislators TODAY to demand they protect Illinois’ homeless and housing services. 🚨

Join CCH, @SHPA_IL and @HousingActionIL in asking your legislators to restore HOME Illinois funding to the FY25 level of $290 million: chicagohomeless.org/homeil

If you have any questions or need assistance with SNAP or other public benefits, contact the CCH Law Project at (800) 940-1119 or Legal Aid Chicago at (312) 341-1070. Learn more: chicagohomeless.org/SNAP-cha…

Join us for Yoga at We the People (1229 N North Branch St) on Sat, June 6 at 10:30 am. Proceeds from this class benefit CCH and our mission to build community power and advance racial equity through organizing, advocacy, legal assistance, and education. act.chicagohomeless.org/a/yo…

📢 CCH will hold its 3-day Community Organizing Training next month, May 27 – 29. Grow (or dust off) your organizing skills and get insight into how CCH runs and wins city and state-level advocacy campaigns! Interested in joining us? Fill out this form: act.chicagohomeless.org/a/co…

Despite the unique challenges people experiencing homelessness, service providers, and advocates faced in 2025, CCH and our partners remain vigilant in standing up for the rights of people who have been forced into homelessness. Read our annual report: chicagohomeless.org/annual-r…

Spring is the season of new beginnings — and that includes your record. Find out if you qualify for free cannabis expungement through New Leaf Illinois, a State of Illinois funded program that provides free legal assistance. 872-NEW-LEAF or newleafillinois.org

HB 1429 will ensure people experiencing homelessness are allowed to exist in public spaces without fear of punishment. We need to get this bill passed TODAY! Email or call your state rep to share your support for the bill. 💻: bit.ly/hb1429yes |📱:  bit.ly/hb1429yes-call

Did you see the Chicago Tribune’s editorial opposing HB 1429 yesterday? Until we have enough housing that is accessible for everyone who needs it, people need a place to exist without fear of punishment. Share your support for 1429 here: bit.ly/support-hb1429

🚨 Take Action! The Illinois House of Representatives must vote YES on HB 1429 by Friday, April 17 to stop local governments from punishing people for experiencing homelessness. Urge them to vote yes on HB 1429 or thank them for their support: bit.ly/hb1429yes

Stop Illinois municipalities from punishing people for experiencing homelessness! Please submit a witness slip as a PROPONENT of "HFA 1” to help move this bill forward by 10 am tomorrow (Wednesday).  chicagohomeless.org/take-act…
